senses.gloss: f. (יָשַׁט) reaching over, handing over, opp. הוֹלָכָה q. v.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:59">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵈ</cite> <he>ולמה לא תנינן ה׳ עמהון</he> why is not reaching an object over (from one territory to another) counted among the labors forbidden on the Sabbath? <cite ref="Zevachim 14a:17">Zeb. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי הוֹשָׁטַת ידו</he> as far as one may reach over with his hand (without moving from his place).
